description: Compare the central regulatory linker of human MFF with C. elegans MFF-1/MFF-2, and check whether C. elegans encodes MiD49/MiD51-type DRP-1 receptors
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session()
def getseq(a):
    r=S.get(f'https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta',timeout=60); r.raise_for_status()
    return ''.join(r.text.split('\n')[1:])
hs=getseq('Q9GZY8'); ce1=getseq('Q19343'); ce2=getseq('P91344'); dm=getseq('Q961C9')

# Human MFF regulatory sites (UniProt Q9GZY8 features retrieved earlier)
sites={146:'S (AMPK)',149:'T',151:'S (SUMO K151 is adjacent)',155:'S',157:'S',172:'S (AMPK)',200:'T',202:'S',229:'S',233:'S',295:'S'}
print('Human MFF phosphosite region (UniProt modified residues):')
print('  residues', sorted(sites), ' -> all lie in 115-295, i.e. the central linker between repeat R2 (ends ~86) and the coiled coil (291)')
print('  human linker length R2end(86) -> CC start(291) =', 291-86)
# worm equivalent
print('  Ce MFF-1 linker: last repeat ends ~76 -> predicted CC start 105 =', 105-76)
print('  Ce MFF-2 linker: last repeat ends ~43 -> predicted CC start 118 =', 118-43)
print()
print('Human MFF 140-180 (AMPK/SUMO regulatory segment):', hs[139:180])
print('Ce MFF-1 77-104 (entire corresponding linker):   ', ce1[76:104])
print()
# ---- are MiD49/MiD51 (MIEF2/MIEF1) present in C. elegans? ----
def search(q,size=10):
    r=S.get('https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search',params={'query':q,'size':size,
            'fields':'accession,protein_name,gene_names,organism_name,length'},timeout=60)
    return r.json()['results']
print('UniProt search: MiD49/MiD51/MIEF in C. elegans')
for q in ['(gene:MIEF1 OR gene:MIEF2 OR protein_name:"mitochondrial dynamics protein") AND organism_id:6239',
          'protein_name:"mitochondrial fission process" AND organism_id:6239',
          '(gene:fis-1 OR gene:fis-2 OR gene:drp-1) AND organism_id:6239']:
    res=search(q,8)
    print(' Q:',q[:70],'-> n=',len(res))
    for e in res:
        print('   ',e['primaryAccession'],[g.get('geneName',{}).get('value') for g in e.get('genes',[])],
              e['sequence']['length'],
              e.get('proteinDescription',{}).get('recommendedName',{}).get('fullName',{}).get('value',
              (e.get('proteinDescription',{}).get('submissionNames') or [{}])[0].get('fullName',{}).get('value','')))

# ---- figure: linker-length comparison ----
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,3.2))
labels=['Hs MFF','Dm Tango11','Ce MFF-2','Ce MFF-1']
lastrep=[86,78,43,76]; ccstart=[291,236,118,105]; total=[342,277,161,158]
y=np.arange(len(labels))
ax.barh(y,[a for a in lastrep],color='#2E6F9E',label='N-terminal repeat region')
ax.barh(y,[c-l for c,l in zip(ccstart,lastrep)],left=lastrep,color='#C9C9D1',label='central linker (regulatory in human)')
ax.barh(y,[t-c for t,c in zip(total,ccstart)],left=ccstart,color='#D9A441',label='coiled coil + tail anchor')
for i,(l,c) in enumerate(zip(lastrep,ccstart)):
    ax.text((l+c)/2,i,f'{c-l} aa',ha='center',va='center',fontsize=9)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(labels); ax.set_xlabel('residue')
ax.set_title('Central linker that carries the human AMPK sites S146/S172 is 205 aa in human MFF and 29 aa in C. elegans MFF-1',fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8,frameon=False,loc='lower right')
for sp in ['top','right']: ax.spines[sp].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
